name: codex
doc: OpenAI Codex CLI on a ChatGPT subscription. Several accounts = several CODEX_HOME directories, each with its own login (auth.json) and quota. A directory without auth.json is not an account.

auto_reset._doc: Redeems a Codex "Full reset" when a fresh reading shows the weekly window exhausted (run-model claim_reset). {bin} = the runtime bin/, {account} = the account label (default or CODEX_HOME=<path>).

coordinator_env_doc: variables this CLI sets in the processes it starts: when one is set, the coordinator session runs on this CLI, on the account its account_env names in this process (unset = default home). AUTOPILOT_COORDINATOR=<cli>[/<account>] overrides.
